Review: サンプルマーケットで当選しました🔥【ニューロペップ8リセット トナー】【ニューロペップ8リセット アンプルセラム】こちらの化粧水と美容液をいただきましたのでレビューさせていただきます✨✳︎【トナー】水々しくて軽いテクスチャで水分がスッと肌に入ります！混合肌ですが、刺激も全く感じず、重ね付けしてもベタつきなし✨コットンより手でなじませたほうが潤いを感じました☺️✳︎【セラム】結構とろみはあり、ジェルのように粘度がある感じですが、重すぎず、肌にピタッと密着しました✨使用前後の写真の通り、ハリが出て毛穴が目立ちづらくなりました！！トナー後に使うとツヤ感が更にUPしました😆✳︎【使用感】刺激なし🙆♀️香りはトナーのほうが発酵美容液のような感じの香りがしますが、セラムはあまり感じませんでした！1日しか使用していないため、劇的変化はありませんが、ハリツヤ感は見た目に分かるくらい出ました✨使い続けて整えていくタイプの商品かと思います。✳︎【おすすめタイプ】肌の土台を整えたい方ハリツヤ不足ゆらぎが気になる方水分をしっかり入れたい方✳︎混合肌でもベタつかず問題なく使用できました😊 価格帯を考えても満足度は高めだと思います🔥

Review_en: I won at the sample market 🔥 [Neuropep 8 Reset Toner] [Neuropep 8 Reset Ampoule Serum] I received this lotion and serum, so I would like to review it ✨✳︎ [Toner] The watery and light texture absorbs moisture into your skin easily! I have combination skin, but it didn't irritate my skin at all, and it didn't feel sticky even when I layered it.✨It felt more moisturizing when I applied it with my hands than with cotton.☺️✳︎[Serum] It's quite thick and has a gel-like viscosity, but it's not too heavy, and it adheres tightly to my skin✨As you can see in the before and after photos, it's firmer and my pores are less noticeable! ! When I used it after the toner, the shine was even better 😆✳︎ [Usage] No irritation 🙆♀️ The toner smells more like a fermented serum, but the serum doesn't really smell like it! I've only used it for one day, so there hasn't been a dramatic change, but I can see it's firmness and shine✨I think it's the type of product that will improve with continued use. ✳︎[Recommended type] For those who want to improve the foundation of their skin, those who are concerned about lack of firmness, lack of shine, and fluctuations, and those who want to add moisture ✳︎ Even on combination skin, I was able to use it without any stickiness and no problems 😊 Considering the price range, I think the level of satisfaction is high 🔥

Review: 日本初上陸というフレーズと共にネットの広告で何度か見かけて気になって応募したところ、当選しました！ありがとうございます😊私はトナーとセラムをいただき、届いたその日の夜から連続で5日間使用しました。私の肌は敏感乾燥肌で、でも油分の多いお手入れをするとニキビができる難しい肌質です。こちらの商品は敏感肌でも心地良いテクスチャーということで期待していました。実際に使用した感想は、トナーは少しとろみのあるテクスチャーで、１回でさっぱり、２回つけるとしっとりしました。香りもほんのりお花の香りで使いやすいです。セラムは私に届いた物はジェルくらいの粘度があり、スポイトで出すとポッテリした感じ。のばすとベタベタはしないのですが、私の場合は塗った後ツヤというよりテカテカに見えるようで、娘から顔テカテカだよ！？と言われました笑あと、使った初日にピリピリと刺激を感じてショックでした。１日あけて３日目からまた使用してみたところ、刺激は感じなくなったのですが、敏感肌でも刺激を感じる場合があるという事を記しておきます。また、セラムはスポイトの吸いが悪くうまく出て来なかったり、セラムが容器のふちにたまり容器の口がセラムでデロデロになったり、とにかく容器のストレスがすごくて⋯。申し訳ありませんがリピは無しです。箱や容器に日本語表記があったり、商品説明の冊子が入っているのはわかりやすくて良かったです。

Review_en: I saw the phrase "first landing in Japan" in several online advertisements and was intrigued, so I applied and was selected! Thank you 😊 I received the toner and serum and used them for 5 days straight from the night they arrived. My skin is sensitive and dry, but it's difficult for me to get acne if I use oil-rich skin care. I had high hopes for this product as it has a texture that is comfortable even for sensitive skin. My impressions after actually using it were that the toner had a slightly thick texture and felt refreshing after one application, and moisturized after applying it twice. It has a light floral scent and is easy to use. The serum I received had a gel-like consistency, and when dispensed with a dropper, it felt like a lumpy mess. It doesn't feel sticky when you spread it out, but in my case it looks shiny rather than shiny after application, and my daughter says her face is shiny! ? lol Also, I was shocked because I felt a tingling sensation on the first day I used it. When I tried using it again on the third day after a day's delay, I no longer felt any irritation, but I would like to note that even sensitive skin may experience irritation. Also, the serum doesn't come out properly due to poor suction from the dropper, serum accumulates at the edge of the container and the mouth of the container becomes mushy with serum, and the container is under a lot of stress. Sorry, there are no repeat orders. It was nice that the boxes and containers were written in Japanese and included a booklet with product explanations that was easy to understand.
Review_ko: 여러 온라인 광고에서 '일본 최초 상륙'이라는 문구를 보고 호기심이 생겨 지원을 하게 되었고, 선정되었습니다! 감사합니다 😊 토너와 세럼을 받고 배송받은 날부터 5일동안 바로 사용했어요. 제 피부는 민감하고 건조한 편인데 오일이 풍부한 스킨케어를 사용하면 여드름이 나기 어렵습니다. 민감한 피부에도 편안한 사용감이 특징인 제품이라 기대가 컸어요. 실제로 사용해본 소감은 토너는 살짝 걸쭉한 질감으로 1회 바르면 산뜻한 느낌이 들었고, 2회 바르면 촉촉해지는 느낌이었어요. 은은한 꽃향기가 나고 사용하기 편해요. 제가 받은 세럼은 젤 같은 제형이었는데, 스포이드를 사용하면 덩어리진 듯한 느낌이 들었습니다. 펴발랐을 때 끈적이는 느낌은 아닌데, 저 같은 경우는 바르고 나면 윤기보다는 윤기가 나는 것 같고, 딸아이가 얼굴이 윤기가 난다고 하네요! ? ㅋㅋㅋ 그리고 저도 사용 첫날 따끔거림을 느껴서 깜짝 놀랐어요. 하루 지체 후 3일째에 다시 사용해보니 전혀 자극이 느껴지지 않았으나 민감한 피부라도 자극이 있을 수 있다는 점 참고 부탁드립니다. 또한, 드로퍼의 흡입력이 약하여 세럼이 제대로 나오지 않고, 세럼이 용기 가장자리에 쌓이고, 세럼으로 인해 용기 입구가 흐물흐물해지며, 용기가 많은 스트레스를 받게 됩니다. 죄송합니다. 재주문은 없습니다. 상자와 용기에는 일본어로 적혀 있고, 알기 쉬운 제품 설명이 적힌 책자가 포함되어 있어서 좋았습니다.

Review: 画像↓↓↓使用前の右頬(夜)個人的に1番と言っていいほど気になっている赤み。画像↓↓↓使用して１週間後の右頬(朝)【使用するケア用品】朝、洗顔なし。拭き取り化粧水(オードムーゲ)のみ。夜、洗顔あり。その後化粧水(無印)+本商品+乳液(無印)【使ってみて】一回目の使用後は、若干のヒリヒリ感があって、｢あ、今、合わないのかも。｣と思い、洗い流しました。そのため肌の土台を先に整えるために、本商品使用前に１週間保湿を最も優先した化粧水+乳液を使いました。その後２回目を使用したところ、ヒリヒリ感はなく安定して使用できました。肌の状態を先に整えた方がぜっっったいにいいです。毎朝鏡をかならず見る機会があるので、見るには見るのですが、はじめは何も変化がなかったです。3.4回目辺りで赤みが少し引いてきました。5.6.7回目は赤みはだいぶ引いてきて、比較していくとかなり安定してきました。ですが、少しだけ朝の感想が気になりました。【まとめ】肌の調子が悪いと、本商品の成分だと強いのかなと思います。しっかり肌の調子を整えてから使うのをオススメします。赤みは引きます。

Review_en: Image ↓↓↓Right cheek before use (at night) Redness is something I personally worry about the most. Image ↓↓↓Right cheek after 1 week of use (morning) [Care products used] Morning, no face wash. Only wipe-off lotion (Eau de Mouge). There is a face wash at night. After that, lotion (unbranded) + this product + emulsion (unbranded) [Try it] After the first use, I felt a slight stinging sensation, and I thought, "Oh, maybe it doesn't suit me now," so I washed it off. Therefore, in order to prepare the foundation of my skin first, I used a lotion + emulsion that prioritized moisturizing for a week before using this product. After that, when I used it for the second time, there was no stinging sensation and I was able to use it stably. It's definitely better to get your skin conditioned first. I always have the opportunity to look in the mirror every morning, so I keep looking, but at first I didn't notice any changes. By the 3rd or 4th time, the redness had subsided a little. Review_en: I received it at the sample market. thank you! I really liked the serum. It is rich in ingredients and gives the impression of being an "aggressive anti-aging serum." It was more than I expected! It has a very aggressive ingredient list, including retinol, vitamin C, niacinamide, and copper peptide, but even I, who have sensitive skin, can use it without any irritation. However, I refrain from using it when my skin is unstable, such as before my period, just in case. By using it at a time when your skin is in good condition, you will feel a synergistic effect and it will bring you closer to your ideal skin. *Contains fragrance. Since the cleansing oil has a high oil content, it leaves a bit of a residue even after rinsing with lukewarm water, and personally I found it a bit heavy. If you have oily skin, it may also cause acne. I think it's for people with dry skin. It also has fragrance.

Review: トナーとセラムのセットを選択しました。トナー(化粧水)：テクスチャーは、とろみのあるしっとりとした使用感で肌にのせた時の馴染み方がとっても気に入りました。導入効果も兼ねているからか、浸透させた直後は少しベタベタ感を感じますが、その上からセラムやクリーム等を塗布すると、ベタベタ感はなくなりしっかりと保湿されている肌触りになるので、全く問題ないです🙆🏻♀️‎匂いは、化粧品特有の匂いと花束とホテルソープの香りが混ざったような匂いでした。個人的にはとても好みな香りで、スキンケアの時間が楽しみになりました！セラム(美容液)：よくあるとろっとしたセラムではなく、ジェル状のセラムで吸いにくいため、スポイトで2､3回程が適量になるかと思います。ジェル状なので、手からこぼれ落ちにくく塗りやすいです。匂いは、トナーと同じでトナーよりかは薄めです。2つを併せて使った後に、乳液＆クリームまたはクリームのみを基本的なスキンケアとして使用しています。混合肌気味の私でもこのトナーとセラムは顔全体に塗っても肌トラブルが加速せず、調度良い保湿加減です。このまま続けてみて尚良かったらリピートします！

Review_en: I chose a toner and serum set. Toner (lotion): The texture is thick and moist, and I really liked how it blends into the skin when applied. It feels a little sticky right after it soaks in, probably because it also has an introductory effect, but if you apply a serum or cream on top of that, the sticky feeling goes away and your skin feels well-moisturized, so there's no problem at all.The smell was a mix of the typical cosmetic smell, bouquet of flowers, and the scent of hotel soap. Personally, I really like the scent, and I'm looking forward to skin care time! Serum (serum): It is not a typical thick serum, but a gel-like serum that is difficult to absorb, so I think the appropriate amount is 2 or 3 times with a dropper. It's gel-like, so it's easy to apply and doesn't fall off your hands. The smell is the same as toner, but it is lighter than toner. After using both together, I use emulsion & cream or cream alone as my basic skin care routine. Even though I have combination skin, this toner and serum won't cause any skin problems even if I apply it all over my face, and it provides just the right level of hydration. I'll continue this and if it's good, I'll repeat!

Review: 今回サンプルマーケットで当選し、DOPAMYさんの・ニューロペップ8リセットクレンジングオイル・ニューロペップ8リセットアンプルセラムのお2つを頂きました✨ 本当にありがとうございます🙂↕・クレンジングオイル⋯クレンジングも合わないものを使用するとピリピリしたりする敏感肌の私ですが、DOPAMYさんのクレンジングオイルは乗せた瞬間からオイル特有のつっぱりが無く肌に優しいのが分かりました。またピリつきもなく、オイルならではのこっくりとした重たさが無かったのでさらっと使用できました。匂いもまるで森の中にいるようなウッド系の匂いで好みでした！使用方法は、オイルに水を少し含ませてメイクを落とすという事でしたが、乳化してくれるのでマスカラやファンデーションもすぐにするりと落ちてくれました。酒粕が入っているからかクレンジングオイルだけでも、肌がつるんとしてくれて嬉しかったです！日々の肌のお手入れに大活躍しそうです♩・セラム⋯トナーで肌を整えたあと、 美容液を使用しました。こちらのセラムは酒粕が入っていて、他の美容液成分も効能が高そうな物ばかりです。のびが良いけどとろみがあって、ぐんぐんと肌に浸透していく感じが分かりました。セラムも合う合わないがある私の肌ですが、こちらのセラムは塗ったあとも肌荒れも無く直後からハリが出てツヤツヤです！翌朝の肌の調子が楽しみです♩

Review_en: This time I won at the sample market and received two of DOPAMY's Neuropep 8 Reset Cleansing Oil and Neuropep 8 Reset Ampoule Serum✨ Thank you so much 🙂↕・Cleansing oil...I have sensitive skin that gets irritated when I use cleansers that don't suit me, but from the moment I put DOPAMY's cleansing oil on it, I could tell that it was gentle on my skin without the tightness that is typical of oils. It also didn't have any tingling sensation, and it didn't have the thick, heavy feeling that comes with oil, so it was easy to use. I liked the smell as it had a woody smell that made me feel like I was in the forest! The way to use it was to add a little water to the oil and remove makeup, but since it emulsifies, mascara and foundation were easily removed. I was happy that my skin felt smooth even with just the cleansing oil, probably because it contains sake lees! It looks like it will be very useful for daily skin care♩ - Serum After preparing my skin with toner, I used the serum. This serum contains sake lees, and the other serum ingredients also seem to be highly effective. It goes on easily, but it's thick and I feel like it absorbs quickly into my skin. My skin doesn't always suit serums, but with this serum, my skin doesn't get rough even after I apply it, and it's firm and shiny right after I apply it! I'm looking forward to seeing how my skin feels the next morning.

Review_en: I won at the sample market! Thank you. Since the item was shipped from within Japan, the item arrived immediately after the shipping notification. I was thankful that the Japanese translation of the usage instructions was also posted on the product box, so I didn't have to go to the product page to check. I've been using it for a few days, and at first I thought it was odorless, but when I use it on my face, I notice a slight sweet scent, but that's just my imagination. It's penetrating enough that you can apply just one drop to the entire face with a dropper, and it blends well into the skin, but since I was given a sample, I've been using it with a light 2 or 3 drops. The serum is smooth and not sticky, but it has enough moisturizing power to leave your skin soft and smooth. I would like to try using the line when I finish using one.

Review_en: I won at Sample Mart and received DOPAMY Neuropep 8 Reset Cleansing Foam & Ampoule Serum. Since it contains naturally fermented sake lees, it doesn't have a strong odor. The ampoule has a somewhat nostalgic scent 🎶 The cleansing foam also has a slightly acidic PH, so it doesn't make your skin feel tight, which is great for this season when you're concerned about dryness. The texture of the foam is not too hard, it's easy to lather, it's soft and gentle, and it smoothes out your pores.*It also seems to contain argan oil, so you can use it on a daily basis without irritating the skin. The scent of the ampoule is moderately sweet and pleasant. Also, the texture is just the right amount of looseness, making it easy to spread and gives a visibly glossy feel, so I'd like to continue using it. If I were to point out a point that bothers me, it would be that the dropper in the ampoule does not catch the serum well (maybe it depends on the individual, but) My happy dopamine for the skin ♪ I really like this concept ❤️

Review_en: I took out about 1cm of facial cleansing foam and used a net to create fluffy lather. Review_en: I was looking for a beauty serum that specializes in anti-aging care, and I decided to purchase this because it contains luxurious beauty ingredients such as retinol and niacinamide. When I tried using it, I found that the texture blended well with my skin and seemed to penetrate deep into my skin. I thought it was true to be 8 years old, but the next morning after using it, the dullness on my face became brighter, my skin became much plumper, and the wrinkles on my forehead that I was worried about were less noticeable... The redness on my skin was also suppressed, so I wonder if it also has a calming effect? It seems like there's also centella asiatica in there, so maybe that's why? I tend to worry about foreign beauty serums that have a lot of beauty ingredients because they have a unique smell, but this one had a nice, gentle scent, which was a big plus! The packaging is so cute that I'm considering getting a skincare line!

Review: ⭐️ 使用感・テクスチャーについて つけた後の肌表面がべたつかないのにしっとり落ち着いた触り心地になってくれるので、化粧水や乳液を重ねても重さを感じないのが気に入っています。  💧 肌への変化・効果 使い続けて1〜2週間ほど経つと、乾燥によるつっぱり感が和らぎ、肌のモチモチ感がアップ。朝起きたときのハリ感やツヤも感じやすく、化粧ノリが良くなったのも嬉しいポイントでした。  毛穴が明確に引き締まったというほどではありませんが、日常的な肌のキメや潤い感の改善は実感でき、鏡を見るたびに肌が健康的に見える気がします。  また、成分にナイアシンアミドやレチノール、発酵成分などが含まれているおかげか（※製品説明より）、刺激が少なく敏感肌でも使える範囲で、赤みやピリピリ感もほとんど感じませんでした。  特に乾燥が気になる季節やエアコンの乾燥対策としては、一本でしっかり潤いを補える美容液として毎日のルーティンに取り入れやすいです。
SkinType: オプション : タイプ:美容液肌タイプ : 混合肌肌トーン : イエベ肌の悩み : ニキビ・肌荒れ
Review_en: ⭐️ About the feeling and texture: After applying it, the surface of your skin is not sticky, but it feels moist and soothing to the touch, so I like that it doesn't feel heavy even when you apply lotion or emulsion.​ 💧 Changes and Effects on the Skin After 1 to 2 weeks of continuous use, the tight feeling caused by dryness will subside and the elasticity of the skin will improve. When I woke up in the morning, I felt firmer and shinier, and my makeup went on better, which was also a nice point. Although my pores have not clearly tightened, I can feel the improvement in the texture and moisture of my skin on a daily basis, and my skin looks healthier every time I look in the mirror. Also, because it contains ingredients such as niacinamide, retinol, and fermented ingredients (*from the product description), it is mild enough to be used even on sensitive skin, and I didn't experience any redness or tingling sensation. Especially in seasons where you're concerned about dryness or as a countermeasure against dry air conditioning, this serum is easy to incorporate into your daily routine as it provides ample moisture.

SkinType: オプション : タイプ:美容液肌タイプ : 乾燥肌肌トーン : イエベ肌の悩み : ニキビ・肌荒れ, 毛穴, 乾燥
Review_en: There was a slight change in about 2 weeks! Dents near the inner corners of the eyes and fine lines near the nasolabial folds? I was concerned about this, but when I used this only at night, I felt like my skin became plumper. The texture is smooth, it clings lightly to your fingers, and when you put it on your skin, it feels like it absorbs easily. It's not heavy, but it does feel like it's applied. It seems like it can be completely moisturized by layering it, but it's a waste, so I use a cream instead. The scent is almost odorless, so even people who don't like the scent of skin care products can use it. If I had to say just one thing, it's that the dropper is difficult to use. You have to use a lot of force to suck up the contents, so I would like to see an improvement in that area. I hope that if I continue to use it, my skin condition will stabilize. Thank you for your continued support!

Review: サンプルマーケットで頂きました☆『－8歳』『童顔肌』というキャッチコピーで、見た時から使ってみたいと思っていたので当選嬉しい！何より嬉しかったのが、敏感肌の自分でも安心して使えるレチノールがついに見つかってしまった事！本っ当に何の刺激もなく使えました。低刺激や敏感肌用を歌ってても、塗った傍から肌がムズムズし出す商品や、目の周りだけ痒みが出たり、塗った時は大丈夫でも翌朝赤みが顔中で世界地図みたいになる商品もある中で、これは本当に何の刺激もなく赤みも出ず、肌荒れも起きませんでした！しかも、届いてから4日続けて夜の美容液として使用してますが、連続使用しても問題が起こりません！『刺激ゼロ』は本当だった〰️！なのに美容成分は16種類♡配合量や成分の組み合わせの問題なんですかね？肌が敏感な方にほど試して貰いたい美容液です！しかも肌がキメ細やかで艶やかになる！笑った時にできる目の周りのシワもプリプリしてきて気にならなくなってきました！特にレチノールを使えなかった方にオススメしたいです。これは本当に大丈夫ですよ(*˘︶˘*)9.｡.:*テクスチャーは割りとサッパリめなので、手持ちの基礎化粧品の邪魔にならないのも良い。朝、美容液を使う方もベタつかないのでメイクの邪魔にならないと思います。
SkinType: オプション : タイプ:美容液肌タイプ : 混合肌肌トーン : ブルベ肌の悩み : 毛穴, しわ・たるみ
Review_en: I received it at Sample Market ☆ I've been wanting to try it ever since I saw the catchphrase "-8 years old" and "baby-faced skin," so I'm glad I won! What made me most happy was that I had finally found a retinol that even I, who have sensitive skin, can use with confidence! I was able to use it without any irritation at all. Even if they claim to be hypoallergenic or for sensitive skin, there are some products that make my skin feel itchy as soon as I apply them, some that cause itching only around my eyes, and some products that are okay when I apply them but end up with redness all over my face like a world map the next morning, but this one really didn't cause any irritation, didn't cause any redness, and didn't cause any rough skin! What's more, I've been using it as a night serum for 4 days in a row since I received it, and I haven't had any problems even with continuous use! “Zero stimulation” was true〰️! However, there are 16 types of beauty ingredients ♡ Is it a problem with the amount and combination of ingredients? This serum is a must-try for those with sensitive skin! Moreover, your skin will become smoother and more glossy! The wrinkles around my eyes that appear when I smile have become smoother and no longer bother me! I especially recommend it to those who have not been able to use retinol. This is really okay (*˘︶˘*)9.｡.:*The texture is relatively light, so it's good that it doesn't interfere with the basic cosmetics you already have. For those who use serum in the morning, I don't think it will interfere with makeup because it is not sticky.
Review_ko: 샘플마켓에서 받았습니다 ☆ "-8세" "동안 피부"라는 캐치프레이즈를 보고 전부터 꼭 써보고 싶었는데 당첨되어서 기쁘네요! 가장 기뻤던 점은 민감성 피부인 저도 안심하고 사용할 수 있는 레티놀을 드디어 발견했다는 점이에요! 전혀 자극 없이 사용할 수 있었어요. 저자극, 민감성 피부라고는 하지만 바르자마자 피부가 가렵게 되는 제품도 있고, 눈가만 가려워지는 제품도 있고, 바르고 나면 괜찮은데 다음날 아침 세계지도처럼 얼굴 전체가 붉어지는 제품도 있는데 이 제품은 정말 자극도 없고 붉어짐도 없고 피부가 트러블도 나지 않았어요! 게다가 나이트세럼으로 받은 후 4일 연속 사용하고 있는데 계속 사용해도 트러블이 전혀 없었어요! “자극 제로”가 사실이었습니다〰️! 그런데 미용성분은 16종이나 있어요♡ 성분의 양과 배합이 문제인가요? 민감한 피부를 가진 분들이 꼭 사용해보고 싶은 세럼이에요! 게다가 피부가 더욱 매끄러워지고 윤기가 나네요! 웃을 때 생기던 눈가 주름이 부드러워져서 더 이상 신경쓰이지 않게 됐어요! 특히 레티놀을 사용하지 못하셨던 분들에게 추천드립니다. 이거 진짜 괜찮네요 (*˘︶˘*)9.｡.:*사용감이 비교적 가벼워서 이미 가지고 계신 기초화장품에 방해가 되지 않아서 좋아요. 아침에 세럼을 사용하시는 분들은 끈적임이 없어서 메이크업에 방해가 되지 않을 것 같아요.

Review: スポイトタイプなのであまり早く開封したくないのですが、評価しなければならないので使ってみました。かなりとろみのあるテクスチャーです。(とろみあるし中見えないから最後まで吸い上げる自信がない)とろみはあるけどちゃんと肌に入っていってくれましたが、劇的に肌がふっくらして一時的に毛穴が目立たなくなるとかもなく、一回の使用では特に凄さはわかりません。オマケで洗顔フォームも頂きましたが、最近韓国の基礎化粧品ばかり使ってたら、ピーリング作用のあるものばかりなので、肌が薄くなってきてしまい、この洗顔フォームにもピーリング作用があるようなので、こちらは肌が元に戻って毛穴汚れが気になる時に使ってみようかと思います。てかレビューページの仕様変わったんですね。めちゃくちゃ打ちにくいです。あと画像は絶対アップしなきゃいけないっぽいのがめんどくさすぎます。
SkinType: オプション : タイプ:美容液＆洗顔肌タイプ : 脂性肌肌トーン : イエベ肌の悩み : 毛穴, しわ・たるみ
Review_en: Since it's a dropper type product, I didn't want to open it too quickly, but I had to evaluate it, so I gave it a try. It has a fairly thick texture. (It's thick and I can't see inside, so I don't have confidence to suck it all the way up.) It's thick, but it gets into my skin properly, but it doesn't dramatically plump up my skin or temporarily make my pores less noticeable, so I can't really tell how amazing it is after just one use. I also received a facial cleansing foam as a bonus, but recently I've been using only Korean basic cosmetics, and they all have exfoliating properties, so my skin has become thinner.This facial cleansing foam also seems to have exfoliating properties, so I think I'll try using this when my skin returns to its original state and I'm concerned about my pores getting dirty. I guess the specifications of the review page have changed. It's extremely hard to hit. Also, it's too much of a hassle to have to upload images.
Review_ko: 드로퍼형 제품이다 보니 너무 빨리 개봉하고 싶지는 않았지만 평가를 해야 해서 한번 써보기로 했습니다. 상당히 두꺼운 질감을 가지고 있습니다. (두꺼워서 속이 안보여서 끝까지 빨아들일 자신이 없어요.) 두꺼운데 피부에 제대로 스며들지만 드라마틱하게 피부가 통통해지거나 일시적으로 모공이 눈에 띄지 않게 되어서 한 번만 사용해도 얼마나 놀라운지 모르겠어요. 클렌징 폼도 덤으로 받았는데 최근 한국 기초화장품만 사용하고 있는데 다 각질제거 효과가 있어서 피부가 얇아졌어요. 이 클렌징폼도 각질제거 효과가 있는 것 같아서 피부가 원상태로 돌아오고 모공이 더러워질까 걱정되면 꼭 사용해 봐야겠다는 생각이 듭니다. 리뷰 페이지의 사양이 변경된 것 같습니다. 치는 것이 매우 어렵습니다. 게다가 이미지를 업로드해야 하는 번거로움도 너무 큽니다.

Review_en: I received it at the sample market. First of all, it's very good that you can get a cleansing balm just by twirling it, which is something you don't often see in Japanese products. With the jar type, I lost the spatula halfway through, and I ended up picking it up directly with my fingers, so I thought it wasn't very clean...but I'm thankful for the sanitary aspect...I didn't smell anything on it, and it actually smelled like the balm itself. It's not too bad, just a little bit of something like that, so I've never thought that it stinks. I'm satisfied because it removes makeup and eyeliner that can be seen with the naked eye. Sometimes there are cleansers that don't remove even the visible eyeliner... (though it's better not to get it in your eyes) Some cleansers hurt when you just twirl them around your eyes, but this one didn't stain my eyes at all, so I'm glad. I have dry and sensitive skin, but after using it about 10 times, I am very satisfied with the way it washes, as it doesn't make my skin feel tight or rough right after I wash it. It's so good that I think I might want to buy more when I run out.

Review: このくるくる回して出す仕様が気になり、購入してみました‹‹\(´ω` )/››商品としても個人的に素晴らしい✨と思ったので、レビューを残します。【クレンジング力】自宅にあった、落ちにくそうなもの達で検証してみました🔎画像2～4枚目を見ていただけるとわかりやすいのですが、1回のクレンジングでかなりしっかり落ちます！腕に塗ったあと、30分以上置いてからクレンジングをしてみましたが、1回目でウォータープルーフのマスカラもほとんど落ちているので、洗浄力は高いのではないかと思います👍画像にはないのですが、毛穴に入りこんだコンシーラーはどのくらい落とせるのかも試して見ました。こちらも肉眼でコンシーラーが残っているのが分からないくらいしっかりクレンジングできてました😉実際に顔にも使ってますが、このクレンジングバームだけでメイクが落ちるので、W洗顔は要らないなぁと、思ってます。【使用感】クレンジング後、特に肌がつっぱるという感じはありませんでした。パサつくということもなく、逆に洗ったところがツルツル、ちょいモチという感じになりました！とはいえ、クレンジング後に、なるはやでスキンケアをした方がいいと思います。容器の作りとして、くるくるすると削られたバームが出てくるのですが、見てるのが既に楽しく、出しすぎてしまう恐れがありますので、お気をつけを…！！半回転分くらいあれば十分な気がします🤔バームの中に指を入れたり、わざわざスパチュラでとったりしなくていいので、煩わしさも激減です🥰✨【その他】商品の使用感ではありませんが、購入者への配慮が素敵😍だと思った点があったので、記載させてください！画像枚数の上限で載せることができなかったのですが、アウトボックスと商品の底に日本語の成分表示シールが貼られていました。製造販売元が日本にもあるからだと思いますが、それでも日本語の成分表記や使用方法の記載があると安心出来るので、ありがたいなぁと、思いました🙏🏻✨✨

Review_en: I was curious about the spinning design, so I bought it‹‹\(´ω` )/››I personally thought it was a great product✨, so I'm leaving a review. [Cleansing power] I tested it with items I had at home that seemed hard to remove. It's easy to understand if you look at the 2nd to 4th images, but it comes off pretty well with just one cleanse! After applying it to my arms, I let it sit for at least 30 minutes before cleansing, and most of my waterproof mascara came off after the first use, so I think it has a good cleaning power.Although it's not shown in the image, I also tested it to see how much concealer that had gotten into my pores could be removed. It also cleansed so well that I couldn't see any concealer left with the naked eye 😉 I actually use it on my face, but since this cleansing balm removes my makeup on its own, I don't think I need a double face wash. [Feelings] After cleansing, my skin did not feel particularly tight. It didn't feel dry at all, on the contrary, it felt smooth and a little chewy after I washed it! However, I think it's better to take care of your skin after cleansing. When making the container, the shaved balm comes out when you spin it around, but it's already fun to look at, and you might end up putting out too much, so be careful! ! I feel like half a turn is enough 🤔 You don't have to put your finger in the balm or use a spatula to remove it, so it's much less troublesome 🥰✨ [Others] This isn't about how the product feels, but I thought it was nice to be considerate of the customer 😍, so I would like to write about it! I couldn't post it due to the limit on the number of images, but there was a Japanese ingredient label affixed to the outbox and the bottom of the product. I think it's because the manufacturer is also in Japan, but I still feel relieved that the ingredients and directions for use are written in Japanese, so I'm grateful.

Review_en: The balm comes out in a fairly thin state because it is a type that is first rolled and scraped. Thanks to this, it blends into my skin and makeup very well. I had the impression that the balm itself was difficult to use because it didn't remove makeup when it was dissolved, but this Be bare removes well with just a small amount, so it really removes the clarity, dullness, and roughness of my skin without drying or tightening it. It scrapes and comes out just by turning it, so it's amazing that it always comes out clean even if your hands are wet. I thought it would be difficult to use because I didn't get used to turning the spatula and it wasn't familiar to me, but that wasn't the case at all, and I didn't have to worry about putting away the spatula or washing it, so I wish I had used it sooner. It's a refill type, so it's definitely a repeat purchase.

Review: 今使っているクレンジングが使い切りそうでお得に買えるこちらがを目にし、初めて購入しました。注文した翌日に商品が届き とても有難かったです!クチコミも良かったので思い切ってリフェル付を購入しました！使用した感想は、大満足です。今使っているマスカラが強力で中々落ちずクレンジング難民だったのですがこちらは綺麗に落ちました!そして、使用後はつっぱらず化粧水を付けると肌がモチモチになります。このお値段でこのクオリティは買って良かったです。ただ、これは1注文に1個という見落としていた私の落ち度ですがおまけで付いてたリップクリームも匂い、使用感共に良かったので月に3本リップクリームを消費する私はレフィルじゃなく そんな金額も変わらないし単体を2つ購入すれば良かった🥺🥺🥺と思いました。次またリップクリームのおまけが付いてたら単体2つ購入します!ポーチも大容量入るし 可愛いブルーで良さげありがとうございます☺️

Review_en: I bought this for the first time when I saw that it was a great deal because I was about to use up the cleansing I was currently using. The product arrived the day after I ordered it, and I was very grateful! It had good reviews, so I took the plunge and purchased the product with a reference! I am very satisfied with my impressions after using it. The mascara I'm currently using is so strong that it doesn't come off easily, and I was a refugee from cleansing, but this one came off perfectly! Also, after using it, it doesn't feel tight, and when I apply lotion, my skin becomes supple. I'm glad I bought this quality at this price. However, this was my fault as I had overlooked one per order, but the lip balm that came with it as a bonus had a good smell and feel, so I thought I should have bought two individual lip balms instead of refills since I consume three lip balms a month. Next time, if I get the extra lip balm, I'll buy two separately! The pouch has a large capacity, and it's cute and blue, thank you very much ☺️
Review_ko: 지금 사용하고 있는 클렌징을 다 써버리게 되어서 정말 좋은 것 같아 처음 구매했습니다. 주문한 다음날 상품이 도착했는데 너무 감사했어요! 후기가 너무 좋아서 참고하고 과감하게 제품을 구매했어요! 사용 후 소감은 매우 만족스럽습니다. 현재 사용하고 있는 마스카라는 너무 강해서 잘 지워지지 않고 클렌징도 난감했는데 이건 완벽하게 잘나왔네요! 그리고 사용 후에도 당기는 느낌이 없고, 로션을 바르면 피부가 부드러워지더라구요. 이 가격에 이 품질을 구입해서 기쁘네요. 하지만 주문당 1개를 빼먹은 내 잘못이었는데 덤으로 같이 온 립밤은 향도 좋고 촉감도 좋아서 한 달에 3개씩 립밤을 소비하니 리필 대신 2개 낱개 립밤을 사야겠다는 생각이 들었다. 다음번에 립밤이 더 생기면 2개 따로 구매해야겠어요! 파우치도 용량도 크고 귀엽고 파란색이네요 너무 감사해요☺️

Review: サンプルマーケットで4点セット当たりました！気になっていたのですごく嬉しいです！ありがとうございます！クレンジングオイル、クレンジングフォーム、トナー、セラムの4点セットです。これ本当に良かったです！私は、薄肌の敏感肌の油田なのに頬は乾燥肌のインナードライで、合わない物を使うとニキビや麦粒腫や赤み等の肌トラブルが非常に起きやすく、トナーやセラムは特にピリピリ痛んだり赤くなる事が多いのに、皮脂は多いので厄介な肌質です。先にトナーとセラムを使用しましたが、ピリピリが全くない！レチノール入ってると絶対ピリピリ痛くなるか赤みが出るのに、数日使っても痛みも赤みも出ないのすごい！トナーもセラムも重ためなのに、ベタつきが全くなく、オイル感もないので、油田持ちの皮脂多めの人も使える！特にセラムにオイルが多めだと一気に荒れてしまうのですが、届いて数日使ってますが全く荒れません！セラムは本当に濃厚な重さのあるセラムで、頬に垂らしてみても下に落ちてこない程なのに、ベタつきが全くないです。ベタつきが本当に苦手なので、本当に良かったです！ベタつきがないのに保湿が足らない訳ではなく、しっかり潤うので、インナードライの人にすごく良さそう。クレンジングオイルとクレンジングフォームも次の日使ってみましたが、ピリピリや赤みも出ず、本当に良かったです！あと香りがめちゃ良い！浸透させた後は香りは消えるので、臭覚過敏でも大丈夫だよ！写真は届いたセットのトナーとセラムを先に使用した為出した物、トナーを手のひらに出した物、トナー使用後にセラムを頬に垂らしてみた物です。素敵な商品ありがとうございます！

Review_en: I won a 4-piece set at the sample market! I'm really happy because I was interested in it! thank you! This 4-piece set includes cleansing oil, cleansing foam, toner, and serum. This was really good! I have thin, sensitive skin, but my cheeks are dry on the inside, so if I use products that don't suit my skin, I tend to get acne, stye, redness, and other skin problems.Toners and serums often cause irritation and redness, but my skin has a lot of oil, so my skin is troublesome. I used the toner and serum first, and there was no tingling sensation at all! When I use retinol, I always get tingling or redness, but it's amazing that I don't get any pain or redness even after using it for a few days! Even though the toner and serum are heavy, they are not sticky at all and don't feel oily, so even oil field workers with oily skin can use them! Especially if there's too much oil in the serum, I get rough skin all at once, but I've been using it for a few days now and it hasn't gotten rough at all! The serum is really thick and heavy, and even when I put it on my cheeks, it doesn't fall down, and it doesn't feel sticky at all. It was really good because I don't really like stickiness! Even though it's not sticky, it doesn't mean it's not moisturizing enough, and it's very moisturizing, so it seems like it'd be great for people with inner dry skin. I also used the cleansing oil and cleansing foam the next day, and it didn't cause any tingling or redness, so it was really good! Also, the scent is really good! The scent disappears after it soaks in, so it's okay even if you're sensitive to smells! The photos are of the toner and serum in the set I received, which I took out because I used them first, the toner I put out on my palm, and the serum I put on my cheeks after using the toner. Thank you for the wonderful product!
Review_ko: 샘플마켓에서 4종세트에 당첨됐어요! 관심이 많았기 때문에 정말 기쁩니다! 감사합니다! 클렌징 오일, 클렌징 폼, 토너, 세럼이 4종 세트로 구성되어 있습니다. 정말 좋았어요! 저는 피부가 얇고 예민한 편인데 볼 속은 건조해서 피부에 맞지 않는 제품을 사용하면 여드름, 다래끼, 홍조 등 피부트러블이 생기기 쉽습니다. 토너나 세럼은 자극과 홍반이 자주 생기는데, 피부에 유분이 많아서 피부가 트러블이 많이 나거든요. 토너와 세럼을 먼저 사용해봤는데 따끔거리는 느낌은 전혀 없었어요! 레티놀을 사용하면 항상 따끔거리거나 붉어지는 증상이 나타나는데, 며칠 사용해도 통증이나 붉어짐이 전혀 느껴지지 않는다는게 신기해요! 토너와 세럼이 무거운데도 끈적임이 전혀 없고 유분감도 없어 지성 피부인 유전 작업자도 사용 가능해요! 특히 세럼에 오일이 너무 많으면 피부가 한꺼번에 거칠어지는데, 며칠째 사용하고 있는데 전혀 피부가 거칠어지지 않더라구요! 세럼이 정말 걸쭉하고 묵직한데, 볼에 올려도 흘러내리지 않고, 끈적임도 전혀 없어요. 제가 끈적이는 걸 별로 안 좋아해서 정말 좋았어요! 끈적이지 않는다고 해서 보습이 부족하다는 뜻은 아니고, 보습력이 매우 좋아서 속건성 피부이신 분들이 사용하시면 좋을 것 같습니다. 다음날 클렌징 오일과 클렌징 폼도 사용했는데 따끔거림이나 붉은기가 전혀 없어서 정말 좋았어요! 게다가 향도 정말 좋아요! 스며들면 향이 사라져서 냄새에 민감한 분들도 괜찮아요! 사진은 제가 받은 세트에 들어있는 토너와 세럼을 먼저 사용하기 때문에 꺼낸 모습과 손바닥에 덜어낸 토너, 그리고 토너 사용 후 볼에 바르는 세럼의 모습입니다. 훌륭한 제품에 감사드립니다!

Review_en: Thank you for winning the sample set. I have used this pack before and it is very moisturizing and moisturizing! It can be used in all seasons, but is highly recommended for winter. I guess that's just how I do it lol.If I put on lotion after taking a bath, I could take care of my body's skin and it didn't make me feel dry. The face wash didn't feel tight and I thought it might be good for daily use. I think all of these products are highly recommended for people with dry skin.

Review: （20代混合肌、最近は乾燥よりの肌、花粉による肌荒れ）2週間ほど使用してみました。匂いは全てあまりキツくなく、個人的に桃のような香りに感じました。クレンジングオイルは乳化もして使用しましたが、メイク残りを感じませんでした。（マスカラはお湯でオフできるものを使用）洗顔フォームは泡立ちがとてもよく、流した後もつっぱらずとても気に入っています。トナーは水よりのテクスチャーでトロミ感は少ないです。花粉で荒れてしまった肌には最初沁みるようか感覚はありましたが、使っていくうちに肌荒れがよくなってきました！美容液セラムは1回のスポイトで出る量が少なく感じます。1度じゃ足りない気がするので2スポイトしてます。1回目で全体に馴染ませて、2回目に肌荒れしているところや乾燥が気になるところに重ね塗りしています。ベタつかなく、とても使いやすいです。パックは薄く、密着感があります。夜にこちらのパックを使用するとクリームを塗らなくても潤いが残ってる感じがしました。（トナー、セラムはパック後に使用）総合的にとてもよく、ライン使いができるセットがとてもお得だと思います！2週間ほど使用し、お肌のキメが整い、透明感が出てきた感じがします。最近は肌質が乾燥に傾いてきていて化粧水等悩んでいましたが、揺らぎがちなお肌にもとても良い商品だと思います。

SkinType: オプション : タイプ:5点セット ニューロペップ８R　 クレンジング+洗顔フォーム+ トナー+セラム+マスク肌タイプ : 混合肌肌トーン : ブルベ
Review_en: (I'm in my 20s with combination skin, my skin has been drying lately, and my skin is rough due to pollen) I've been using it for about 2 weeks. The smell wasn't too strong, and I personally felt it smelled like peach. I used the cleansing oil as an emulsion, but I didn't notice any makeup residue. (Use mascara that can be removed with hot water.) The facial cleansing foam foams very well and doesn't feel sticky after rinsing off, which I really like. The toner has a more textured texture than water and doesn't feel thick. At first, it felt like it was soothing to my pollen-induced rough skin, but as I continued to use it, my rough skin started to get better! The amount of beauty serum that comes out with one dropper seems to be small. I feel like 1 dropper is not enough, so I use 2 droppers. The first time I apply it, I let it absorb all over my skin, and the second time I apply it on areas where my skin is rough or dry. It's not sticky and is very easy to use. The pack is thin and has a close fit. When I used this pack at night, I felt that my skin was moisturized even without applying cream. (Toner and serum are used after the pack) Overall, it's very good and I think it's a great value for a set that can be used as a line! After using it for about 2 weeks, my skin feels smoother and clearer. Lately, my skin has been getting drier and I've been worried about using lotion, but I think this is a great product for my sensitive skin.

(뜨거운 물로 지울 수 있는 마스카라를 사용하세요.) 세안 폼은 거품이 잘 나고, 세안 후에도 끈적임이 없어 정말 마음에 듭니다. 토너는 물보다 질감이 더 촘촘하고 끈적한 느낌이 없습니다. 처음에는 꽃가루로 인해 거칠어진 피부를 진정시켜주는 느낌이었는데, 사용할수록 거칠어진 피부가 좋아지기 시작했어요! 스포이드로 나오는 미용액의 양은 적은 것 같아요. 1방울로는 부족할 것 같아 2방울을 사용합니다. 처음 바르면 피부 전체에 흡수시키고, 두 번째는 피부가 거칠거나 건조한 부위에 발라줍니다. 끈적이지 않고 사용하기 매우 쉽습니다. 팩이 얇고 밀착감이 좋습니다. 밤에 이 팩을 사용하면 크림을 바르지 않아도 피부가 촉촉해지는 느낌이 들었습니다. Review: サンプルマーケットで商品を無償で頂きました！こんなお得なセットをいただけて、とても嬉しいです。ありがとうございます。【使用感の追記しました】国内発送とはいえ1日で届き驚きました。とても丁寧な梱包で中にはDOPAMYのシリーズの説明書が入っていてありがたかったです。それぞれの箱にも日本語で成分等の記載がありました。【トナー】テクスチャーはシャバシャバとまでいかず若干とろみがありますが、すぐに肌に吸収されサラサラになりました。ワントーン明るくなった気がします。甘い香りがしますがそんなに持続しないので個人的には気になりませんし、敏感肌な私でも問題なく使えました。【セラム】トナーと一緒に使っていますが2日ほど使っただけで肌がつるつるになりました。内側は保湿されてるのに表面はサラサラになるので不思議です。エマルジョンやクリームはないので、手持ちのものをトナーとセラム後に使用しています。【洗顔フォーム】少しつぶつぶが入っていて使用後はつるつるしっとりになります。毎日使えると記載があったので低刺激なのに角質除去でき乾燥しない点が良いです。【クレンジング】敏感肌&乾燥肌でクレンジングオイルはヒリヒリするものが多く、普段はクリームで落としてるのですがこちらはアイメイクもしっかり落ちて肌荒れもせず使えて感動しました。こんなに良いと思うものは中々ないのでメガ割で購入しようと思います！

Review_en: I received the product for free at the sample market! I'm very happy to have received such a great set. thank you. [Added notes on usage] I was surprised that it arrived in one day, even though it was shipped domestically. It was packaged very carefully and there was a manual for the DOPAMY series inside, which I was grateful for. Each box also had ingredients written in Japanese. [Toner] The texture is not too thick and is a little thick, but it absorbs into the skin quickly and becomes smooth. I feel like it's gotten a little brighter. It has a sweet scent, but it doesn't last that long, so I personally don't mind it, and even I, who have sensitive skin, could use it without any problems. [Serum] I use this together with a toner, and my skin has become smoother after just two days of use. It's strange because the inside is moisturized but the outside is smooth. I don't have any emulsion or cream, so I use what I have after my toner and serum. [Facial cleansing foam] Contains a little bit of texture, leaving you feeling smooth and moisturized after use. It says that you can use it every day, so I like that it's mild, but it also removes dead skin cells and doesn't dry you out. [Cleansing] I have sensitive and dry skin, and many cleansing oils sting, so I usually use creams to remove them, but I was impressed that this product removed eye makeup well and didn't irritate my skin. There aren't many things that I think are this good, so I'm thinking of purchasing it at a mega discount!

[토너] 질감은 너무 두껍지 않고 약간 두껍지만 피부에 빠르게 흡수되어 매끈하게 마무리됩니다. 조금 더 밝아진 것 같아요. 달달한 향이 나지만 지속력이 그리 길지 않아서 개인적으로는 상관없고, 피부가 예민한 저라도 문제 없이 사용할 수 있을 것 같아요. [클렌징] 피부가 민감하고 건조한 편이라 클렌징 오일이 따가워서 보통 크림을 사용해서 제거하는데, 이 제품은 아이메이크업도 잘 지워지고 피부에 자극도 안가서 감동받았어요. 이렇게 좋다고 생각하는 물건이 별로 없어서 대폭 할인해서 구매하려고 합니다!

Review: サンプルマーケットで4点セットをいただきました【クレンジングオイル】香りがやや強めでとろみがあります。ウォータープルーフマスカラにはなじみにくいので落とすには時間がかかります。最終的には指で優しく挟んで擦りながら落としました。ウォータープルーフマスカラを重ね塗りしている方には厳しいかもしれません。擦らないように優しく押さえるようになじませて洗い流したあとは油分の多いクリームを塗ったような感じが残りメイクが落ちているのがわからなかったのでクレンジングフォームでダブル洗顔しました。【クレンジングフォーム】オイルほど香りは強くありません。ネットに1cmほど出して泡立てました。泡立ちがよく顔全体を覆えます。メイクを落とす時は摩擦を避けているので泡を優しく数秒転がして洗い流しました。オイルのあとのヌルつきはちゃんと落ちました。【トナー】とろみはなく手に出した時はシャバシャバしているので多めに使わないと保湿できないのかなと思いましたがたっぷり使わなくてもちゃんと保湿されました。ベタつきもなくさっぱりしています。もしかすると乾燥強めの方は何回かにわけて塗った方がいいかもしれません。【セラム】スポイトで落とすとぽってりとしたセラムで乗せたいことろに直接垂らせます。ベタつきもテカテカにもならないしかといって保湿が弱いわけでもないです。セラム塗ったあとの肌はちゃんとしっとり仕上がりました。トナーもセラムもさっぱり系なので乾燥肌の方は保湿力が足りないと感じるかもしれないなと思いました。

SkinType: オプション : タイプ:4点セット ニューロペップ８R　 クレンジング+洗顔フォーム+ トナー+セラム肌タイプ : 混合肌肌トーン : ブルベ肌の悩み : 毛穴, くすみ・色むら, しわ・たるみ
Review_en: I received a 4-piece set at Sample Market [Cleansing Oil] It has a slightly strong scent and is thick. Waterproof mascara is difficult to absorb and takes time to remove. In the end, I gently pinched it with my fingers and rubbed it off. This may be difficult for those who apply multiple layers of waterproof mascara. After applying it gently without rubbing it and rinsing it off, it felt like I had applied a cream with a lot of oil and I couldn't feel the makeup being removed, so I double-washed my face with cleansing foam. [Cleansing foam] The scent is not as strong as that of oil. I poured about 1cm onto the net and lathered it. It lathers well and covers the entire face. When removing makeup, I avoid friction, so I gently rolled the foam around for a few seconds and rinsed it off. The slimy feeling left behind by the oil has been removed properly. [Toner] It's not thick, and when I took it out, it was a bit runny, so I thought I'd have to use a lot to keep it moisturized, but it was moisturizing even if I didn't use a lot. It feels refreshing without any stickiness. If you are prone to dry skin, it may be better to apply it several times. [Serum] When removed with a dropper, the serum becomes thick and drips directly onto the area you want to apply. Just because it doesn't make you feel sticky or shiny doesn't mean it's not moisturizing enough. After applying the serum, my skin felt really moisturized. Both the toner and serum are refreshing, so I thought those with dry skin might not find them moisturizing enough.
Review_ko: 샘플마켓에서 4종 세트를 받았습니다. [클렌징 오일] 향이 살짝 강하고 걸쭉한 느낌이에요. 워터프루프 마스카라는 흡수가 어렵고 제거하는 데 시간이 걸립니다. 마지막에는 손가락으로 살살 꼬집어 문질러 주었습니다. 워터프루프 마스카라를 여러 겹 바르는 분들에게는 어려울 수도 있습니다. 문지르지 않고 가볍게 바르고 헹구어 낸 후, 마치 오일을 잔뜩 머금은 크림을 바른 듯한 느낌이 들고 메이크업이 지워지는 느낌이 없어서 클렌징 폼으로 두 번 세안을 했습니다. [클렌징폼] 오일 향만큼 강하지 않아요. 네트에 1cm 정도 붓고 거품을 냈습니다. 거품이 잘나고 얼굴 전체를 커버해줍니다. 메이크업을 지울 때 마찰을 피하기 때문에 폼을 몇 초간 가볍게 롤링한 후 헹구어 냈습니다. 오일로 인해 남겨진 끈적한 느낌이 제대로 제거되었습니다. [토너] 두껍지 않고, 꺼냈을 때 살짝 묽은 느낌이라 많이 발라야 촉촉할 줄 알았는데, 많이 사용하지 않아도 촉촉해요. 끈적임 없이 산뜻한 느낌이에요. 피부가 건조해지기 쉬운 분들은 여러 번 덧발라주시는 것이 좋을 것 같습니다. [세럼] 드로퍼로 떼어내면 세럼이 걸쭉해지면서 바르고 싶은 부위에 직접 떨어집니다. 끈적임이나 윤기가 느껴지지 않는다고 해서 보습이 부족한 것은 아닙니다. 세럼을 바르고 나니 피부가 정말 촉촉해지는 느낌이 들었어요. 토너와 세럼 모두 산뜻한 느낌이라 건성피부이신 분들은 보습력이 부족할 수도 있을 것 같았어요.

Review_en: I won at the sample market✨️I was very surprised as I didn't expect to win. I haven't used the cleansing and pack yet, so here are my other impressions...Face washing foam: It lathered quite well even without using a foaming net. After washing, it is not sticky and feels moist. Toner: It has a thick texture that blends well into the skin and feels like it goes into the skin easily. If I had to compare it to other companies' products, I think Skin and Love's toner would be close. I usually abuse soapy toners, so when I used them like that, they turned sticky. The only negative point was that when I peeled off the silver sticker for the first time, the inner lid also came off and the contents overflowed. Serum: The texture is gel-like. I was able to use the appropriate amount on my whole face. It's very difficult to suck with the included dropper. You can only suck in about 1/3 of the dropper. General review: I usually only use harsh products such as facial scrubs and needle serums. This product feels very gentle and mild, so even people with sensitive skin can use it without any problems. As for the effects, it's only been 3 days since I started using it, but my skin condition hasn't changed even after switching to this series, so I don't think it's because it doesn't suit my skin. I was able to use it without any problems even on my skin, which tends to get rough the next day if I use cosmetics that don't suit me.

Review_en: I won at the sample market. Luxurious 5-piece set! thank you. These are my impressions after using it for a few days on my shaky skin who is currently suffering from hay fever. If I had to say one thing, I personally like it when I can easily see how much is left, so I thought it would be even better if it was a container where I could see the contents. I would like to continue using it. thank you very much.

Review: サンプルマーケットでいただきました。サンプルサイズで届くかと思ったら、なんと全部現品サイズで届きました。現在使っている他のスキンケア製品もありまして、まずはセラムと、洗顔を使ってみました。他の製品は試した上、またレビューをアップデートしていきます。使い初めて1週間経った感想です。洗顔は、洗顔パックと普通の泡立て洗顔の両方使える記載がありました。韓国では最近そういったダブル使いが可能な洗顔タイプが多いですが、実際使うのが初めてです。洗顔自体は白いペストのようなテクスチャで、なめらかで顔に伸ばしやすいです。顔にぬると体温によっては少し乳化させ、少し透け感のある乳白に代わって、中に白い粒子？みたいなものが見えます。3分ほど置いて、軽くお湯に混ぜながらマッサージして洗い流しました。すごくスッキリした洗い心地で、日焼け止めや眉毛、コンシーラー程度でしたらパックのみでキレイにオフできました。洗顔パックとしては、AHA、BHA、PHAが配合した原因で、いつものアミノ酸洗顔よりは少し洗浄力が高めて、角栓や皮脂に気になる脂性肌や混合肌向きの印象を受けました。泡立て洗顔としては、泡立てネット利用で泡は立てれるので、パックよりは優しく洗うことができて、乾燥肌はパックではなく、通常の洗顔として使う方が満足度高いと思いました。セラムは、流動性が低めで、とろみのあるテクスチャです。その分、スポイドで取り出す際に毎回量が少し異なって、コツがいる印象です。顔に塗ると、伸ばしやすく、軽いながら保湿力があって、他のセラムに合わせても使いやすいです。ナイアシナマイド、パンテノール、トコフェロール、アスコルビン酸、レチノールが全部一つに入る欲張りセラムで、美白、アンチエイジング、毛穴など一気に悩み解決できるのを楽しみにしてます。その分、朝使うと日焼け止めしっかりする必要がありますので、今は基本夜中心に使っています。もう少し使って、改善があったら改めてアップデートします。

SkinType: オプション : タイプ:5点セット ニューロペップ８R　 クレンジング+洗顔フォーム+ トナー+セラム+マスク肌タイプ : 混合肌肌トーン : イエベ
Review_en: I received it at the sample market. I thought it would arrive in sample size, but it actually arrived in actual size. There are other skin care products that I am currently using, but first I tried the serum and the face wash. I will update the review after trying other products. This is my impression after using it for the first time for a week. There was a description that the face wash can be used both as a face wash pack and as a regular foaming face wash. Recently in Korea, there are many face wash types that can be used twice, but this is the first time I have actually used one. The face wash itself has a white pesto-like texture, which is smooth and easy to spread on the face. When you apply it to your face, it emulsifies a little depending on your body temperature, and instead of a slightly translucent milky white, there are white particles inside? I see something like this. I left it on for about 3 minutes, mixed it with warm water, massaged it in, and washed it off. It was very refreshing and I was able to remove sunscreen, eyebrows, and concealer with just the pack. As a face wash pack, I got the impression that because it contains AHA, BHA, and PHA, it has a slightly higher cleaning power than the usual amino acid face wash, and is suitable for oily skin or combination skin that is concerned about keratin plugs and sebum. As a foaming face wash, you can use the foaming net to create bubbles, so you can wash your face more gently than with a face pack, and I think it would be more satisfying for dry skin to use it as a regular face wash instead of a face pack. The serum is less fluid and has a thicker texture. For that reason, when taking it out with a dropper, the amount is slightly different each time, so it seems like there is a trick to it. When applied to the face, it spreads easily, is lightweight yet moisturizing, and is easy to use with other serums. I'm looking forward to using this serum that contains niacinamide, panthenol, tocopherol, ascorbic acid, and retinol all in one to solve skin whitening, anti-aging, and pore problems all at once. However, if I use it in the morning, I need to apply a good sunscreen, so I basically use it at night now. I'll use it a little more and update if there are any improvements.
Review_ko: 샘플마켓에서 받았습니다. 샘플 사이즈로 올 줄 알았는데 실제 사이즈로 도착했어요. 현재 사용하고 있는 다른 스킨케어 제품도 있는데 먼저 세럼과 세안제를 사용해보았습니다. 다른 제품도 사용해본 후 리뷰를 업데이트하겠습니다. 일주일간 처음 사용해본 소감입니다. 세안제 팩으로 사용이 가능하고 일반 거품세안제로도 사용 가능하다는 설명이 있었습니다. 최근 국내에는 2회 사용이 가능한 세안제가 많이 나와 있는데 실제로 사용해 본 것은 이번이 처음입니다. 세안제 자체는 흰색 페스토 같은 질감으로 부드럽고 얼굴에 잘 펴발립니다. 얼굴에 바르면 체온에 따라 조금씩 유화가 되는데, 살짝 반투명한 유백색 대신 안에 하얀 입자가 들어있죠? 나는 이런 것을 본다. 3분 정도 방치한 후 따뜻한 물과 섞어서 마사지하고 씻어냈습니다. 정말 산뜻하고 팩만으로도 선크림, 눈썹, 컨실러까지 지울 수 있었어요. 세안 팩으로는 AHA, BHA, PHA가 함유되어 있어 일반 아미노산 세안제보다 세정력이 살짝 높고, 각질과 피지가 걱정되는 지성 피부나 복합성 피부에 적합하다는 인상을 받았습니다. 포밍 세안제로는 포밍망을 이용하면 거품이 생기기 때문에 팩보다 부드럽게 세안이 가능하고, 건성 피부라면 팩 대신 일반 세안제로 사용하면 더 만족스러울 것 같아요. 세럼은 유동성이 적고 질감이 더 두껍습니다. 그래서 스포이드로 꺼낼 때마다 양이 조금씩 다르기 때문에 뭔가 비결이 있는 것 같습니다. 얼굴에 바르면 쉽게 퍼지고, 가벼우면서도 촉촉하며, 다른 세럼과 함께 사용하기 쉽습니다. 나이아신아마이드, 판테놀, 토코페롤, 아스코르빈산, 레티놀을 한 번에 함유한 이 세럼을 사용해 피부 미백, 안티에이징, 모공 고민을 한번에 해결할 수 있을 것 같아 기대가 됩니다. 하지만 아침에 사용하려면 자외선 차단제를 잘 발라야 해서 지금은 기본적으로 밤에 사용하고 있어요. 좀 더 사용해보고 개선사항이 있으면 업데이트하도록 하겠습니다.

Review: サンプルマーケットで商品を無償で頂きました。 ありがとうございます！  全体的に「肌を整えながらしっかり保湿できる」印象で、刺激感が少なく使いやすかったです。  クレンジングオイルはとろみのあるテクスチャーで乳化も早く、メイクがスルッと落ちます。洗い上がりがつっぱらず、しっとり感が残るところが気に入りました。  クレンジングフォームは泡立ちが良く、角質ケア成分入りなのに毎日使っても乾燥しにくい優しい使用感。洗顔後は肌がなめらかになる感じがあります。  トナーはほんのりとろみがあり、肌にすっとなじんでしっかり水分補給してくれるタイプ。重たくないのに保湿力があり、肌が落ち着くような使用感でした。  個人的に1番良かったのがセラムで、ベタつかないのにしっかり保湿されて肌がもっちり。翌朝の化粧ノリが良くなり、ツヤ感が出たように感じます。ただ、付属のスポイトは衛生面では良いなと思った反面、少し吸い上げづらい時があったので、もう少し使いやすいと嬉しいなと思いました。  シートマスクは美容液がひたひたで、袋の中にも余るくらいたっぷり入っていました。シートも薄めで肌にピタッと密着するので、動いてもズレにくく使いやすかったです。しっかり保湿されて、外した後ももっちり感が続く印象でした。全体的に鎮静・保湿・ハリケアをバランスよくできるシリーズで、敏感肌寄りの方でも使いやすいと思います。 まだ試して数日なので、使い切ってみて肌状態が安定するようなら、次のメガ割でリピしようと思います！

SkinType: オプション : タイプ:5点セット ニューロペップ８R　 クレンジング+洗顔フォーム+ トナー+セラム+マスク肌タイプ : 乾燥肌肌トーン : ブルベ
Review_en: I received the product for free at the sample market. thank you!  Overall, I had the impression that it ``conditions the skin and moisturizes it well'', and it was easy to use with little irritation.  The cleansing oil has a thick texture that emulsifies quickly and removes makeup easily. I like that it doesn't feel tight after washing and leaves a moist feeling.  The cleansing foam lathers well, and even though it contains exfoliating ingredients, it has a gentle feel that won't dry you out even if you use it every day. After washing my face, my skin feels smooth.  The toner is a slightly thick type that absorbs easily into the skin and provides deep hydration. Although it is not heavy, it is moisturizing and feels soothing to the skin.  Personally, the best thing about it was the serum, which was not sticky but moisturized well and made my skin plump. The next morning, my makeup goes on better and I feel like I have a shiny glow. However, while I thought the included dropper was good in terms of hygiene, it was sometimes a little difficult to suck up, so I thought it would be nice if it were a little easier to use.  The sheet mask was full of serum, and there was so much that there was more than enough in the bag. The sheet is thin and adheres tightly to the skin, so it doesn't shift easily even when you move, making it easy to use. It was very moisturizing and left me with a supple feeling even after I took it off. This series provides a well-balanced overall soothing, moisturizing, and firming care, and I think it's easy to use even for those with sensitive skin. I've only been trying it out for a few days, so if I use it up and my skin condition stabilizes, I'll buy it again at the next mega discount!
Review_ko: 샘플마켓에서 제품을 무료로 받았습니다. 감사합니다!  전체적으로 '피부의 컨디셔닝과 보습력이 좋다'는 인상을 받았고, 자극도 거의 없이 사용하기 편했습니다.  클렌징 오일은 걸쭉한 질감으로 빠르게 유화되어 메이크업을 쉽게 지워줍니다. 세안 후에도 당김이 없고 촉촉한 느낌이 남는 점이 마음에 듭니다.  거품이 잘 나는 클렌징 폼이며, 각질 제거 성분이 함유되어 있음에도 불구하고 매일 사용해도 건조해지지 않는 부드러운 사용감이 특징입니다. 세안하고 나면 피부가 매끈해지는 느낌이 들어요.  토너는 약간 걸쭉한 타입으로 피부에 쉽게 흡수되어 깊은 보습을 선사합니다. 무겁지 않은데도 촉촉하고 피부가 진정되는 느낌이에요.  개인적으로 가장 좋았던 점은 세럼이 끈적이지 않고 촉촉하면서 피부를 탱탱하게 만들어주는 점이었어요. 다음날 아침 화장이 더 잘 발리고 광채가 나는 것 같은 느낌이 들어요. 다만, 동봉된 드로퍼가 위생적인 ​​면에서는 좋다고 생각하면서도 흡입하기가 조금 어려울 때가 있어서 조금 더 사용하기 편했으면 좋겠다는 생각이 들었습니다.  시트마스크에 세럼이 가득 들어 있었는데, 봉지 안에도 넉넉할 정도로 양이 많았어요. 시트가 얇고 피부에 촘촘하게 밀착되어 움직여도 쉽게 움직이지 않아 사용하기 편리합니다. 보습력이 좋아서 떼어내고 난 뒤에도 뽀송뽀송한 느낌이 들었어요. 진정, 보습, 탄력 케어가 전반적으로 균형 있게 이루어져 민감한 피부를 가진 분들도 사용하기 편한 시리즈인 것 같아요. 며칠만 써본거라 다 써서 피부상태가 안정되면 다음 대박 할인으로 재구매 할게요!

Review: 初めてサンプルマーケットで当選しました！ ありがとうございます。せっかく頂いたので 継続的に使ってみた感想かきます。私の肌質 乳液つけるとニキビができてしまって脂性肌によったり、鼻周りが乾燥してしまう混合肌でもあったりという肌質 全ての肌質に一概に合うとは言えないので、似たような肌質の方は肌状態が整うと思うのでおすすめできる商品でした 詳しくは下にかいてます※匂い クレンジング、化粧水、美容液使った時の匂いがどれもいい匂いで好きです！ 洗顔は粘土っぽい匂いで臭いとまではいかないですが無臭に近いです※ 他３つはそこまで強くはないですがふわっと甘いにおいがするのでもしかしたら気になる方は気になるかもしれないです、、使用感 わたしは肌治療をした際のダウンタイム中から使い始めたのですが特に肌が敏感になることもなく逆に治りが早くなったような？整う感じがありました。あとよくニキビが急に顎にできたり口周りにぽつっとできるのですがこちらを使用した際特にできることもなく肌の治安が良くなったような気がしているので継続使用してみますクレンジング ウォータープルーフ のマスカラがちょっと落ちきらなかったのでそこがマイナスです、、結構マスカラつける派なので目元だけは落ちなかった印象でした、 肌は落とした時はもちっとした感覚があり洗いがありはよかったです！ただ最低でも3プッシュくらいしないとだんだんと滑らかにくるくるできないのですぐ乳化させるようにしていました。テクスチャー自体はもったりしていてしゃばしゃばではなかったです洗顔 さっぱりする感じがあるのと、使い続けると肌がすべすべというかもっちり？した感じがありました。成分見たのですがAha bha phaが配合されてるようなので納得です 肌荒れが減ったのがこちらのおかげなのかわからないのですが毛穴ケアができてるのかなと思うと肌の毛穴を詰まなせないところからこちらがよかったのかなと思ってます！こちらは肌にあってたのでリピありです！トナー 肌に浸透した感じがあるので2回ほどレイヤーして使っています。 しゃばしゃばというよりかは少しとろっとしていて保湿されてる感覚があります！ ライン使いするのにこちらはリピありです美容液 ベタベタせずに肌に馴染む感じ？をすぐに感じました。スポイトで中身が上がってこないことが何度もあり、慣れが必要かなと思ってます、、優しく吸い上げればいけました。 美容液は美白系からレチノールなど攻めのものまで色々使っているのですが成分的にも邪魔しないと思ったのでこちらは使用感もよいのもあってリピする予定です！わたしはよくなぎさんやみすたーりゅうさん、えがちゃんのおすすめをみてQoo10でいいものがないか気になったものを試したりしていました。美容系のインフルエンサーのおすすめであまり見ない中で使うのに心配なところも正直ありましたが全部ライン使いしたところ、肌のコンディションを整えてくれてると実際に感じたので今のお気に入りの美容液などと相談しながらも、今回頂いた分を使い終わって肌状態が良ければ洗顔、化粧水、美容液の３つはリピ確実にしようと思いました。メイク落としは取り入れてもいいけど洗い上がりがいいものなら別のものでもいいかなというのが正直なところです、、

The face wash has a clay-like smell, so I wouldn't say it smells bad, but it's close to odorless.* The other three are not that strong, but they do have a soft, sweet smell, so if you're concerned about them, you might be interested.Feelings: I started using them during the downtime after my skin treatment, and my skin didn't become especially sensitive, and on the contrary, it seemed to heal faster. Also, I often get pimples on my chin or around my mouth, but when I used this product, I didn't experience any problems and my skin seemed to be in better condition, so I'll continue using it.The cleansing waterproof mascara didn't come off well, so that's a negative.I tend to wear mascara a lot, so I got the impression that it didn't come off around my eyes, but my skin felt soft when I took it off, and it washed well! However, I couldn't get it to roll smoothly until I pumped it at least 3 times, so I tried to emulsify it right away. The texture itself was thick and not greasy.The face wash feels refreshing, and if you keep using it, your skin will feel smooth. There was a feeling that I looked at the ingredients and it seems like it contains Aha bha pha, so I'm satisfied. I don't know if this is the reason why my skin has less rough skin, but I think it takes care of my pores, and I think this is better because it doesn't clog my skin's pores! This was good for my skin so I'm repeating it! Toner: I feel like it penetrates into my skin, so I layer it twice. Rather than being oily, it feels a little thick and moisturizing! This is a repeat product for line users.Does it feel like it blends into your skin without being sticky? I felt it right away. There have been many times when the contents have not come up with the dropper, so I think I need to get used to it.I was able to just suck it up gently. I use a variety of serums, from whitening to more aggressive ones like retinol, but I think this one won't interfere with the ingredients, so I plan on using this one again as it feels good! I often looked at Nagi-san, My Star Ryu-san, and Ega-chan's recommendations and tried out the ones I was interested in to see if there were any good ones on Qoo10. Review_en: Since this is the first product to arrive in Japan, I found the 5-piece set to be the best value, so I bought the set and have been using it for about 2 weeks now. The cleanser is an oil, but it doesn't get sticky unless you wash it off many times, so it's quite stress-free. However, it is moist and leaves a very good impression. On the other hand, when I wash my face afterwards, it feels slimy even after I wash it off, so I have to wash it off several times to feel refreshed, and if I use this because it has a strong cleaning power, it feels dry even after skin care, so I usually use the d Pro face wash and use this only once or twice a week, and it's just right. The lotion has good penetrating power and is not sticky and is easy to reapply, and the serum afterwards was also moisturizing but not sticky. It's a shame that cream is not available from this line. I use the cream I have on hand. After using the line, my skin is smooth and in good condition. The liquid in the mask also drips and adheres well, leaving your skin plump. I really liked it other than the face wash, so I think I'll be using this for a while!

Review: すげー良いかもです(*´ω｀*)。大好きなUIQをメガ割で買いだめしドミナスは届いてもいないのに。。ほんの出来心でメガデビューでドパミー買ってみてしまったらどハマり致しました(^_^;)。クリームがないのは敢えてなのかな？ですが、ドミナスクリーム買いだめした後の身としてはありがたい。。自分にはほのかに杏の香りに感じますが、クレンジングも洗顔も肌がツルツル☆彡に。お風呂で温めながらクレンジングくるくるしたら、結構ザラザラ取れました。トナーもセラムも肌のツヤがスゴい！レイヤリングしすぎは流石にベタベタしましたが。。ドミナスの白いアンプルとオレンジのNMN？アンプルIOPEのレチノール一緒に使ったら更に肌が光りました。。一緒に使ったらダメな組み合わせかもしれませんが。。超童顔。。恐るべし。。メガデビュークーポンも使い切ってるのに、思わずドパミー更に買いだめしてしまいました。。(・・;)。。買って使えてない基礎化粧品、山ほどあるのに。。どうしましょう。。それくらい、ドパミン良いと思います！国内発送で直ぐに届けて下さるのもありがたい！ですが、すっかり韓国のおまけ文化に慣れてしまうと、おまけがないのは少し淋しいですね。。景品法に引っかかるのでおまけ無理なのかもですけど。。

Review_en: It might be really good (*´ω｀*). I stocked up on my favorite UIQ at a mega discount, and the Dominus hasn't even arrived yet. . I bought Dopamy when it debuted on a whim and was hooked (^_^;). Is it intentional that there is no cream? However, after stocking up on Dominus Cream, I am grateful. . It smells like apricot to me, but it leaves my skin smooth and smooth after cleansing and washing my face. I took a warm bath while cleansing, and was able to remove quite a bit of roughness. Both the toner and serum leave your skin glowing! Too much layering made it sticky. . Dominus white ampoule and orange NMN? When I used it together with Ampoule IOPE's retinol, my skin became even more glowing. . It may be a bad combination if used together. . Super baby-faced. . Scary. . Even though I had used up my mega debut coupon, I couldn't help but stock up on more Dopamy. . (・・;). . There are tons of basic cosmetics that I buy but don't use. . What should we do? . Review_en: I purchased VT's Vitamin C Astaxanthin Mask and Glutathione Tone-on Serum at QOO10 Live. As a bonus, it comes with 200ml of TX Toning Toner, Vitamin C Astaxanthin Serum Mini, and Glutathione Tone-on Serum Mini each♪ The Vitamin C Astaxanthin Mask has a tweezers when you open the lid to store it, making it easy to take out the mask. The sheet mask is thin and the amount of serum is just right without dripping, and it adheres perfectly to the skin. After using it, my pores were tightened and I felt a little toned up. (I was especially impressed by how the pores on my nose were tightened.) The serum of the Glutathione Tone-on Serum is pure white and thick, and when I applied it to my skin, it toned up and felt moisturized. From now on, I'm going to be concerned about sunlight, so I'd like to take proper measures against UV rays and have beautiful skin.

The word astaxanthin caught my eye and I immediately purchased it. I have very sensitive skin, so if it doesn't suit my skin, I'll immediately get itchy, get extremely rough skin, and my skin will become crunchy, so I always choose to use it for the first time before a holiday. After timidly washing my face, I applied lotion and then put on a pack, and it felt a little stinging at first, so I thought it wouldn't work, but I took it off after about 5 minutes, applied a serum or emulsion, and looked at the situation, but I didn't feel any itching or redness, so I was relieved for the time being. I didn't have any itching or other symptoms the next morning, so I used it every night. Impressions of the product: I have been using it without any tingling sensation since the second day. When you remove the pack, your skin will become whiter. The skin becomes moist and supple, and the dryness is calmed down. I am very satisfied with my moist and shiny skin the next morning. This is a product that I want to continue using for a long time. I will definitely be repeating it.

Review: まさかVTの製品が当選するとは思っていなくて、当選通知を見た時は嬉し過ぎて声が出ました。あと何よりビックリしたのは当選してから発送と到着がとても早かったこと。当選から1週間かからず届きました。早速、洗顔後トナーで整えてから使ってみました。まずパッケージを開けると少し黄色く色づいたシートマスクとほのかな柑橘系の香り。嗅覚過敏なので基礎化粧品は特に無香料にこだわっていますが、これは香りといってもほのかなので気にならない程度です。使用感は割とサッパリしていますが、使用後はしっとりに変わります。肌にしっかりと浸透して弾力ある肌に仕上がり、その感じが持続します。マスクシートは色々な韓国コスメのものを試しましたが、この使用感は初めてです。かなり水分量が多くベタベタに仕上がってしまうマスクシートが多い中、これはクセになりそうな心地良さです。シートマスクの頻度は通常週1〜2回程度ですが、もう少し頻繁に使っても肌に負担が無さそうなので今回いただいたものを使い切ったらリピします！

Review_en: I never expected to win a VT product, but when I saw the winning notification, I was so happy that I cried out. What surprised me most was how quickly it shipped and arrived after I won. It arrived in less than a week after winning. I immediately tried using it after washing my face and conditioning it with toner. When you first open the package, you'll see a slightly yellow colored sheet mask and a faint citrus scent. I'm sensitive to smells, so I'm particular about using fragrance-free basic cosmetics, but the scent is so faint that it doesn't bother me. It feels relatively refreshing, but it becomes moist after use. It penetrates deeply into the skin, leaving your skin with elasticity that lasts for a long time. I've tried various mask sheets from Korean cosmetics, but this is the first time I've experienced this feeling. While many mask sheets contain a lot of moisture and end up with a sticky finish, this one is so comfortable that you'll become addicted to it. I usually use sheet masks once or twice a week, but it doesn't seem to be too harsh on my skin even if I use them more frequently, so I'll be using them again once I use up the one I received this time!

Review_en: The smell is typical of citrus-based vitamin C lotions. I like it because it doesn't have a strong smell and it doesn't feel artificially applied. Although the sheet is thin, it is made of a sturdy material and is not a treacherous material, so it is easy to apply and sticks tightly. However, if you look down, the chin and face line will peel off. The shape of the seat was normal, but I felt it lacked a little bit in the nostrils and too much in the cheeks. The size of the face is normal, with long faces and prominent cheekbones. I think it's easy to use as a daily mask. As for the effect, my skin feels moisturized after using it. Perhaps because of this, I felt that my skin glowed and the dull feeling disappeared. I think it's good for retaining water, combating mild dryness, preventing rough skin, and preventing dullness. However, I think it's more of a refreshing hydration product than a moisturizing product. People with super dry skin may not be satisfied. It came with tweezers, but they're small and difficult to use, so I haven't used them. Maybe a handy person can use it?

Review_en: I only bought the 30-piece pack and the astaxanthin serum, but I'm glad there are so many extras! I immediately tried using the serum and the bonus individually wrapped pack. The serum is jelly-like and not a liquid. It will absorb into your skin once you put it on, but it may take a while for it to penetrate. The pack had just the right amount of liquid and was perfect for the eyes, nose, and mouth! While there are many packs that don't fit properly, this is the best pack I've ever used⭐︎I feel like my dullness has disappeared. I would like to continue using the serum and see the results.

Review_en: Purchased at a LIVE event. Inner dry for 50s. I don't like vitamin-based products because they have a lot of oil (because they cause acne), but although the texture of the serum is thick, it doesn't feel oily or sticky. The mask also has no oil content and is not sticky and moisturizing. Compared to my previous vitamin mask, it's definitely better. There is a slight yuzu smell, but it's not an unpleasant artificial fragrance smell and it disappears quickly. I'm sensitive to smells, but I can use this comfortably. I have the PDRN capsule cream, but it was difficult to use and the effect was average, so I chose the serum set and it was the right choice. I currently use VT's PDRN pack, but I would like to use it alternately. There were lots of presents. I'm also really happy with the actual TX toner. When you purchase a set at a VT event, you often receive actual TX toner as a gift, so even though I love TX toner, I have never purchased it myself lol.

Review: パックはサッパリしてて使いやすいです。10〜20分とありますが、20分は乾燥して無理かも。5〜10分で良さそうです。クリームは、このタイプ初めてですが楽しい！ベタつくこともなく、量に気をつければ朝でも大丈夫そう。おまけで新作のアスタキサンチンセラムとグルタチオンセラムの小さいのがついてたんですが、アスタキサンチンセラムは使いやすそうでした。グルタチオンセラムは絶対買いません…セラムじゃなくて下地の間違いでは？という感じ。下地では白すぎだけど。石灰溶かしたみたいなまっっしろでもったりしたテクスチャ。塗ったら馴染むんだろうかと思って恐る恐るつけてみたけど、まったく馴染まず…浸透している感覚もなく、肌表面に白く乗るだけという感じ。洗い落としたかったくらい使用感最悪でした。おまけで試せてよかったです。

Review_en: The pack is refreshing and easy to use. It says 10 to 20 minutes, but 20 minutes might be impossible because it gets dry. 5-10 minutes seems fine. It's my first time using this type of cream, but it's fun! It's not sticky and can be used in the morning as long as you're careful with the amount. As a bonus, it came with a small version of the new Astaxanthin Serum and Glutathione Serum, and the Astaxanthin Serum seemed easy to use. I will never buy a glutathione serum...maybe it's a mistake in the base rather than the serum? That's what it feels like. It's too white for the base though. The texture is pure and smooth, like melted lime. I timidly tried applying it, wondering if it would blend in once I applied it, but it didn't blend in at all...I didn't feel it penetrate, just a white layer on the surface of my skin. It was so bad that I wanted to wash it off. I'm glad I got to try it as an extra.

I think the amount is a little small, but it contains astaxanthin, so it's a great combination! It's comfortable to use and has just the right amount of moisture. It doesn't leave you feeling sticky forever, so it's perfect before makeup. I would like to repeat it until summer♪

Review: 長い間、ニキビ跡や色素沈着に悩んでいるので買ってみました。朝のスキンケアに使ってますが、カプセルクリームの方は特に匂いもなく、塗った直後はベタつくけどすぐに肌になじんでくれます。まだ使用して１ヶ月経ってないので肌に変化は感じないけど、その後のメイクに悪い意味で影響が出たりはしてないので、リピするかは分かりませんがとりあえず1個使い切ってみます。マスクの方はシートは薄いけど液はひたひたで、ズレることなくしっかりフィットしてくれます。でも、とにかくチクチクします。15分はつけたままにしてたけど正直苦痛で、マスクを剥がすと肌にうっすら赤みが出ていました。とはいえ、確かに毛穴はいつもより目立たないというか閉じてる感じがありました。何度か使って慣れたらチクチク感も薄れるんだろうけど、これはリピはしないです。

Review_en: I bought this because I have been suffering from acne scars and pigmentation for a long time. I use it for my morning skin care, and the capsule cream doesn't have a particular smell, and it feels sticky right after I apply it, but it absorbs into my skin quickly. I haven't used it for a month yet, so I haven't noticed any changes in my skin, but it hasn't affected my makeup in a negative way after that, so I don't know if I'll be using it again, but I'll try using it for now. The sheet of the mask is thin, but the liquid is moist and it fits securely without slipping. But anyway, it stings. I left it on for about 15 minutes, but to be honest, it was painful, and when I took the mask off, my skin was slightly red. However, my pores were definitely less noticeable than usual, or rather, they felt like they were closed. I'm sure the tingling sensation will fade after I use it a few times and get used to it, but I won't be using this again.

Better yet, GIFT's TX Toning Toner! This didn't suit me.
